Plot the results of many series

Source: R/plots.R
plot_batch.Rd

plot_batch() draws the cycles (or trends) of a result of mhp_batch() or fmhp_batch(), one panel per series or all in one panel, with the smoothing parameter of each series in its label.

Usage

plot_batch(x, show = c("cycle", "trend"), facet = TRUE, highlight = NULL)

Arguments

x

a result of mhp_batch() or fmhp_batch().

show

"cycle" (default) or "trend".

facet

one panel per series (default TRUE).

highlight

names of series drawn in full colour, the others faded (default NULL: all).

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Change from version 0.1.0. The faceted plot passed linewidth twice (a warning) and ignored highlight; both are corrected.

Author

Muhammad Yaseen (myaseen208@gmail.com)

Examples

data(us_macro)
mb <-
  mhp_batch(
      X          = log(as.matrix(us_macro[, c("gdp", "consumption", "investment")]))
    , max_lambda = 100000
    )
plot_batch(
    x         = mb
  , show      = "cycle"
  , facet     = TRUE
  , highlight = NULL
  )
